apps.name: Döda Kvarter
apps.summary: A zombie roguelike for both screens, set in a Swedish suburb at night.
apps.description: Survive round after round as in Call of Duty Zombies: earn kronor, buy your way through barricades into new districts, find the power, drink Julmust and Snabbkaffe, try Lådan (beware the Dalahäst) and upgrade at Smedjan. Every town is new and the loot gets better every round. Eight bosses from Swedish folklore. The top screen is the game, the bottom screen your inventory, health, ammo and the map. Runs natively at 60 frames a second on both panels.

apps.name: ROCKNIXDS Bank & Trade
apps.summary: A Pokémon bank, legality checker and trading app, built on PKHeX.Core.
apps.description: Reads your game saves (generation 1 to 5), stores Pokémon in boxes of its own, moves them between games through the bank (they change format only when they move up a generation, as Pal Park and Poké Transfer did), checks every one with PKHeX's legality analysis, and trades with another handheld over Wi-Fi, in a lobby or a private room. Close the game before you use it: emulators write their own copy of the save when they quit. Your bank stays in /storage/roms/rocknixds-bank, also when the app is removed.

apps.name: eReaderDS
apps.summary: A two-page ebook reader: hold the handheld sideways like an open book.
apps.description: Each screen shows one page. Reads EPUB and text books, and comics and manga (.cbz). Bookmarks, highlights, a dictionary, themes and fonts, KOReader sync, and books from Standard Ebooks, Project Gutenberg and other catalogs, or sent from your phone or computer over Wi-Fi. Put books in /storage/roms/ebook (the games-roms share's ebook folder); your books, settings and reading places stay there, also when the app is removed. Made by casualducko for the RG DS Plus; it updates itself too, and the Store follows its releases.

apps.name: GBA DS
apps.summary: Game Boy Advance on both screens: the game on one, its own map on the other.
apps.description: A Game Boy Advance emulator made for dual-screen handhelds, built on mGBA. The game plays on the top screen; for 37 games (Castlevania, Metroid, Zelda, Golden Sun, Advance Wars, Mario Kart and more) the bottom screen shows the game's own map, race HUD or unit intel and keeps it current as you play, the way the DS Castlevanias do. It finds the games in /storage/roms/gba (the games-roms share's gba folder) by itself and lists the ones it has second-screen support for; show_all = 1 in its gba-ds.cfg lists every game (the others play on one screen). HOME or a tap on the bottom screen opens its menu: save states, rewind, cheats, display options, Close GBA DS. Its battery saves are the Game Boy Advance list's own, so a game goes on from the same save in GBA DS and in RetroArch; its save states and settings stay when the app is updated or removed. Made by kyannon (free software, GPL-3.0); it updates itself too, and the Store follows its releases.

apps.name: ROCKNIXDS Store
apps.summary: This Store: games and apps for ROCKNIXDS, installed and updated in one press.
apps.description: Lists the games and apps made for ROCKNIXDS, installs them with a tile of their own on the menu's shelf, and keeps them up to date without waiting for a ROCKNIXDS release. Updates to the Store itself come through here too.
